entities.summary: Friedrichsfelde Central Cemetery is a cemetery in the borough of Lichtenberg in Berlin. It was the cemetery used for many of Berlin's Socialists, Communists, and anti-fascist fighters. Zentralfriedhof Friedrichsfelde is a cemetery from Europe. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
